summary: This slice contains the cookbook's front matter (title page and a 236-entry table of contents) and the full recipe body: the “First things” introduction plus 21 chapters of 209 short Problem/Solution recipes, from navigation and search through substitution, global commands, macros and registers, tags, text generation, terminal usage, visual mode, and vimrc/window configuration. Examples are command-focused and assume the reader types along.
